source_text: What a lovely meal.

structure.raw_value: CaHaOp#.What a lovely meal.
structure.script_literal: "CaHaOp#.What a lovely meal."

translation: Co za wspaniała kolacja.

source_text: Yeah! Thanks, Miss Wilson. You’re a hell of a cook.

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Yeah! Thanks, Miss Wilson. You’re a hell of a cook.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Yeah! Thanks, Miss Wilson. You’re a hell of a cook."

translation: Tak! Dziękuję, pani Wilson. Świetnie pani gotuje.

source_text: Well, thank you, ladies.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp>.Well, thank you, ladies.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp>.Well, thank you, ladies."

translation: Dziękuję, drogie panie.

source_text: And, Heather. Thank you for helping me find my first home.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.And, Heather. Thank you for helping me find my first home.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.And, Heather. Thank you for helping me find my first home."

translation: Heather, dziękuję, że pomogłaś mi znaleźć mój pierwszy dom.

source_text: So, what’s the story? You get a raise at work, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.So, what’s the story? You get a raise at work, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.So, what’s the story? You get a raise at work, 1Hero?"

translation: No więc, o co chodzi? Dostałeś podwyżkę, 1Hero?

source_text: Oh, no raise…

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Oh, no raise…
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Oh, no raise…"

translation: Nie, żadnej podwyżki…

source_text: We got lucky. The bank had to offload the property and I happened to be the first to spot the deal.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp>.We got lucky. The bank had to offload the property and I happened to be the first to spot the deal.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp>.We got lucky. The bank had to offload the property and I happened to be the first to spot the deal."

translation: Mieliśmy szczęście. Bank musiał pozbyć się tej nieruchomości, a ja jako pierwszy zauważyłem okazję.

source_text: Can ya find me a home too?

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Can ya find me a home too?
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Can ya find me a home too?"

translation: A może znajdziesz też dom dla mnie?

source_text: And how do you expect to pay for it, young lady?

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.And how do you expect to pay for it, young lady?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.And how do you expect to pay for it, young lady?"

translation: A jak zamierzasz za to zapłacić, młoda damo?

source_text: Maybe we can go in together on an apartment downtown.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx>.Maybe we can go in together on an apartment downtown.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx>.Maybe we can go in together on an apartment downtown."

translation: Może złożymy się razem na mieszkanie w centrum.

source_text: Oh, Chloe. That’s a dangerous place to live.

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp>.Oh, Chloe. That’s a dangerous place to live.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp>.Oh, Chloe. That’s a dangerous place to live."

translation: Oj, Chloe. To niebezpieczna okolica.

source_text: I don’t know if I can handle too much city living.

structure.raw_value: HnFrOp.I don’t know if I can handle too much city living.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrOp.I don’t know if I can handle too much city living."

translation: Nie wiem, czy zniosę życie w wielkim mieście.

source_text: It was just a suggestion.

structure.raw_value: ChBaOp>.It was just a suggestion.
structure.script_literal: "ChBaOp>.It was just a suggestion."

translation: To była tylko propozycja.

source_text: So tell us, 1Hero. Any exciting new stories?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.So tell us, 1Hero. Any exciting new stories?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.So tell us, 1Hero. Any exciting new stories?"

translation: No to opowiadaj, 1Hero. Masz jakieś nowe, ekscytujące historie?

source_text: Yeah! Investigating any murders?

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Yeah! Investigating any murders?
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Yeah! Investigating any murders?"

translation: Tak! Prowadzisz jakieś śledztwo w sprawie morderstw?

source_text: Murders!? I don’t think so.

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp>.Murders!? I don’t think so.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp>.Murders!? I don’t think so."

translation: Morderstwa!? Chyba nie.

source_text: You know I can’t talk too much about work… But I will say that I have a new case.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You know I can’t talk too much about work… But I will say that I have a new case.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You know I can’t talk too much about work… But I will say that I have a new case."

translation: Wiesz, nie mogę za dużo mówić o pracy… Ale zdradzę, że mam nową sprawę.

source_text: Someone broke into the church?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp>.Someone broke into the church?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp>.Someone broke into the church?"

translation: Ktoś włamał się do kościoła?

source_text: Oh, that? My boss had me investigate noises at the church.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Oh, that? My boss had me investigate noises at the church.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Oh, that? My boss had me investigate noises at the church."

translation: A, to? Szef kazał mi zbadać hałasy dochodzące z kościoła.

source_text: Turned out it was just a wild animal loose in the building.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Turned out it was just a wild animal loose in the building.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Turned out it was just a wild animal loose in the building."

translation: Okazało się, że po budynku biegało dzikie zwierzę.

source_text: Sounds lame. Where are all the murders?

structure.raw_value: HnSaOp.Sounds lame. Where are all the murders?
structure.script_literal: "HnSaOp.Sounds lame. Where are all the murders?"

translation: Brzmi nudno. A gdzie te wszystkie morderstwa?

source_text: What kind of animal was it? Raccoon? Coyote?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.What kind of animal was it? Raccoon? Coyote?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.What kind of animal was it? Raccoon? Coyote?"

translation: Co to było za zwierzę? Szop? Kojot?

source_text: Uhh… A cat.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Uhh… A cat.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Uhh… A cat."

translation: Eee… Kot.

source_text: So exciting.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp>.So exciting.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp>.So exciting."

translation: Ale emocje.

source_text: There is this other case…

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.There is this other case…
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.There is this other case…"

translation: Jest jeszcze ta druga sprawa…

source_text: Do you all remember what happened at Saint Dame University?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Do you all remember what happened at Saint Dame University?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Do you all remember what happened at Saint Dame University?"

translation: Pamiętacie, co wydarzyło się na Uniwersytecie Saint Dame?

source_text: You’re working on the murder case from Saint Dame University?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp>.You’re working on the murder case from Saint Dame University?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp>.You’re working on the murder case from Saint Dame University?"

translation: Prowadzisz śledztwo w sprawie morderstw na Uniwersytecie Saint Dame?

source_text: Why would the North Santiva police be working on a case on the other side of the state?

structure.raw_value: CaWoOp.Why would the North Santiva police be working on a case on the other side of the state?
structure.script_literal: "CaWoOp.Why would the North Santiva police be working on a case on the other side of the state?"

translation: Czemu policja z North Santiva miałaby prowadzić sprawę na drugim końcu stanu?

source_text: The woman involved in those crimes was seen here in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.The woman involved in those crimes was seen here in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.The woman involved in those crimes was seen here in North Santiva."

translation: Kobietę powiązaną z tymi zbrodniami widziano tutaj, w North Santiva.

source_text: Madalyn?

structure.raw_value: ChShOp>.Madalyn?
structure.script_literal: "ChShOp>.Madalyn?"

translation: Madalyn?

source_text: You know her name?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.You know her name?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.You know her name?"

translation: Znasz jej imię?

source_text: Wow! You’re hunting her down? What do you have on her? Where is she?

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Wow! You’re hunting her down? What do you have on her? Where is she?
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Wow! You’re hunting her down? What do you have on her? Where is she?"

translation: Co!? Szukacie jej? Co o niej wiecie? Gdzie ona jest?

source_text: It’s nothing. She’s likely long gone…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s nothing. She’s likely long gone…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s nothing. She’s likely long gone…"

translation: To nic takiego. Pewnie już dawno stąd wyjechała…

source_text: I shouldn’t talk about it.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I shouldn’t talk about it.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I shouldn’t talk about it."

translation: Nie powinienem o tym mówić.

source_text: I’m sure you’re being careful out there.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp>.I’m sure you’re being careful out there.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp>.I’m sure you’re being careful out there."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że na siebie uważasz.

source_text: You don’t often hear about a woman killer.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.You don’t often hear about a woman killer.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.You don’t often hear about a woman killer."

translation: Rzadko słyszy się o morderczyni.

source_text: She didn’t just murder, she’s a kidnapper.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx>.She didn’t just murder, she’s a kidnapper.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx>.She didn’t just murder, she’s a kidnapper."

translation: Nie tylko mordowała — porywała ludzi.

source_text: The woman… She was the mother superior at the church.

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp>.The woman… She was the mother superior at the church.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp>.The woman… She was the mother superior at the church."

translation: Ta kobieta… Była przełożoną zakonnic przy kościele.

source_text: Yeah. I met her while I was at SDU. I’m lucky I got out of there.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx>.Yeah. I met her while I was at SDU. I’m lucky I got out of there.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx>.Yeah. I met her while I was at SDU. I’m lucky I got out of there."

translation: Tak. Poznałem ją, kiedy studiowałem na SDU. Miałem szczęście, że udało mi się stamtąd wydostać.

source_text: I’d like to see that woman try and kidnap me. I’d pound her real good!

structure.raw_value: HnMaAg.I’d like to see that woman try and kidnap me. I’d pound her real good!
structure.script_literal: "HnMaAg.I’d like to see that woman try and kidnap me. I’d pound her real good!"

translation: Chętnie zobaczyłabym, jak ta kobieta próbuje mnie porwać. Dałabym jej niezły wycisk!

source_text: I had no idea you had met Madalyn. You went to the chapel for your economics classes?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.I had no idea you had met Madalyn. You went to the chapel for your economics classes?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.I had no idea you had met Madalyn. You went to the chapel for your economics classes?"

translation: Nie miałam pojęcia, że spotkałeś Madalyn. Chodziłeś do kaplicy na zajęcia z ekonomii?

source_text: It’s nothing. I just happened to see her. That’s all.

structure.raw_value: ChBaEx>.It’s nothing. I just happened to see her. That’s all.
structure.script_literal: "ChBaEx>.It’s nothing. I just happened to see her. That’s all."

translation: To nic takiego. Po prostu ją widziałem, tyle.

source_text: Between East State University’s sex scandals and the murders at Saint Dame, I’m starting to wonder what’s going on with our education system.

structure.raw_value: CaWoOp.Between East State University’s sex scandals and the murders at Saint Dame, I’m starting to wonder what’s going on with our education system.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoOp.Between East State University’s sex scandals and the murders at Saint Dame, I’m starting to wonder what’s going on with our education system."

translation: Po skandalu seksualnym na Uniwersytecie East State i morderstwach na Saint Dame zaczynam się zastanawiać, co się dzieje z naszym systemem edukacji.

source_text: That’s why I say, to hell with college.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.That’s why I say, to hell with college.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.That’s why I say, to hell with college."

translation: Dlatego mówię: niech diabli wezmą studia.

source_text: What’s your plan, Hannah? Marry a rich guy?

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.What’s your plan, Hannah? Marry a rich guy?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.What’s your plan, Hannah? Marry a rich guy?"

translation: Jaki masz plan, Hannah? Poślubić bogacza?

source_text: You don’t think a rich guy would want a little country girl like me?

structure.raw_value: HnAnDe.You don’t think a rich guy would want a little country girl like me?
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDe.You don’t think a rich guy would want a little country girl like me?"

translation: Myślisz, że bogacz nie chciałby takiej dziewczyny ze wsi jak ja?

source_text: Little?

structure.raw_value: ChFlOp>.Little?
structure.script_literal: "ChFlOp>.Little?"

translation: Małej?

source_text: Well I ain’t fat!

structure.raw_value: HnAnDeNo1.Well I ain’t fat!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDeNo1.Well I ain’t fat!"

translation: No co? Nie jestem gruba!

source_text: I’d love it if you and Chloe went to the same school.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp>.I’d love it if you and Chloe went to the same school.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp>.I’d love it if you and Chloe went to the same school."

translation: Bardzo bym chciała, żebyś chodziła do tej samej szkoły co Chloe.

source_text: We get it, Mom.

structure.raw_value: ChAnOp>.We get it, Mom.
structure.script_literal: "ChAnOp>.We get it, Mom."

translation: Rozumiemy, mamo.

source_text: I’m just sayin’...

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp>.I’m just sayin’...
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp>.I’m just sayin’..."

translation: Tylko mówię...

source_text: I think that’d be lovely. You need your book learning too, young lady.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I think that’d be lovely. You need your book learning too, young lady.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I think that’d be lovely. You need your book learning too, young lady."

translation: Myślę, że to byłoby cudowne. Nauka też ci się przyda, młoda damo.

source_text: Oh, Ma. You never needed any of that.

structure.raw_value: HnSaEx.Oh, Ma. You never needed any of that.
structure.script_literal: "HnSaEx.Oh, Ma. You never needed any of that."

translation: Och, mamo. Tobie nic z tego nie było potrzebne.

source_text: You want to work on the farm your whole life, be my guest.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.You want to work on the farm your whole life, be my guest.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.You want to work on the farm your whole life, be my guest."

translation: Jeśli chcesz spędzić całe życie na farmie, proszę bardzo.

source_text: That actually sounds pretty fun.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp>.That actually sounds pretty fun.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp>.That actually sounds pretty fun."

translation: W sumie brzmi całkiem fajnie.

source_text: Ha! You want to wake up at the crack of dawn every morning and bust your ass?

structure.raw_value: HnFlOpNo4.Ha! You want to wake up at the crack of dawn every morning and bust your ass?
structure.script_literal: "HnFlOpNo4.Ha! You want to wake up at the crack of dawn every morning and bust your ass?"

translation: Ha! Chcesz codziennie wstawać o świcie i harować jak wół?

source_text: I can get used to it.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp>.I can get used to it.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp>.I can get used to it."

translation: Mogę się przyzwyczaić.

source_text: Then why don’t you and 1Hero come to my place tomorrow and help me with my chores.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.Then why don’t you and 1Hero come to my place tomorrow and help me with my chores.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.Then why don’t you and 1Hero come to my place tomorrow and help me with my chores."

translation: To może ty i 1Hero przyjdziecie jutro do mnie i pomożecie mi w obowiązkach?

source_text: Don’t you try and weasel out of doing your share, young lady.

structure.raw_value: CaAnOp.Don’t you try and weasel out of doing your share, young lady.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnOp.Don’t you try and weasel out of doing your share, young lady."

translation: Tylko nie próbuj się wymigać od swojej części pracy, młoda damo.

source_text: Oh! That sounds like it’ll be fun.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp>.Oh! That sounds like it’ll be fun.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp>.Oh! That sounds like it’ll be fun."

translation: Och! To brzmi jak dobra zabawa.

source_text: And, 1Hero. You gotta come too. It’s Saturday. You can’t work.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.And, 1Hero. You gotta come too. It’s Saturday. You can’t work.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.And, 1Hero. You gotta come too. It’s Saturday. You can’t work."

translation: A ty, 1Hero, też musisz przyjść. Jest sobota, nie możesz pracować.

source_text: You want to come with me, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp>.You want to come with me, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp>.You want to come with me, 1Hero?"

translation: Chcesz ze mną iść, 1Hero?

source_text: Oh, uhh… I guess I could.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Oh, uhh… I guess I could.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Oh, uhh… I guess I could."

translation: Eee… Chyba mógłbym.

source_text: You damn well better!

structure.raw_value: HnAnOp.You damn well better!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnOp.You damn well better!"

translation: Nawet nie próbuj się wykręcić!

source_text: I’m always trying to get 1Hero to come to the gym with me. Maybe Hannah will have better luck getting him into shape.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx>.I’m always trying to get 1Hero to come to the gym with me. Maybe Hannah will have better luck getting him into shape.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx>.I’m always trying to get 1Hero to come to the gym with me. Maybe Hannah will have better luck getting him into shape."

translation: Ciągle próbuję namówić 1Hero, żeby poszedł ze mną na siłownię. Może Hannah lepiej pójdzie z wyrobieniem mu formy.

source_text: Hey! I’m in great shape!

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Hey! I’m in great shape!
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Hey! I’m in great shape!"

translation: Hej! Jestem w świetnej formie!

source_text: He sure is. A handsome fellow if I say so myself.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.He sure is. A handsome fellow if I say so myself.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.He sure is. A handsome fellow if I say so myself."

translation: Owszem. Przystojny z niego facet, jeśli mogę tak powiedzieć.

source_text: Ma! Don’t say that about him.

structure.raw_value: HnAnAgNo1.Ma! Don’t say that about him.
structure.script_literal: "HnAnAgNo1.Ma! Don’t say that about him."

translation: Mamo! Nie mów tak o nim.

source_text: I’m only teasing. We all know 1Hero is a hunk.

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp>.I’m only teasing. We all know 1Hero is a hunk.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp>.I’m only teasing. We all know 1Hero is a hunk."

translation: Tylko się droczę. Wszyscy wiemy, że 1Hero to ciacho.

source_text: Come on, ladies, you’re making me blush.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Come on, ladies, you’re making me blush.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Come on, ladies, you’re making me blush."

translation: Dajcie spokój, dziewczyny, rumienię się.

source_text: God. What’s wrong with you all?

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe>No1.God. What’s wrong with you all?
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe>No1.God. What’s wrong with you all?"

translation: Boże. Co z wami jest nie tak?

source_text: Hannah! You hardly bust your ass.

structure.raw_value: CaAnOpNo1.Hannah! You hardly bust your ass.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnOpNo1.Hannah! You hardly bust your ass."

translation: Hannah! Ty się przecież nie przemęczasz.
